'''Chips with cheese and gravy''' is a popular fast food in the Isle of Man and is a common menu in many takeaway restaurants.

== Ingredients==
* 200 g oven [[Cookbook:Chips|chips]]  (french fries)
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* 300 g grated packed [[Cookbook:Cheddar cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 200 g [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 200 g all-purpose [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]] 
* 4 cans of beef [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]] 
* 10 g [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 220°C and spread the chips onto an oiled [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]].
# Bake the chips for around 15–20 minutes until they are slightly golden.
# After about 5 minutes add grated cheese on top of the chips and continue cooking.
# In a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] melt in the butter and flour and mix continuously.
# Cook on a low heat and slowly add the beef broth and black pepper. Stir continually.
# When the chips are ready, divide between plates and add the gravy as desired.
